_note: Declarative regression cases for the seed curator (tools/seed_curator.py) over shared/feeds/feeds.json. Real-world scope uses OCPS (public) and Monarch Learning Academy (private). No real student data — feed metadata is public.

evals.name: safe_404_removal_is_logged_and_revertible
evals._note: Executable since R6 via seed_curator --self-test: offline and write-free (temp audit log, in-memory catalogs; the live catalog and ledger are never touched). It exercises the real validate/propose/apply/revert functions and reports OBSERVED values, asserted here. A confirmed removed_404 auto-applies a remove logged with mode:auto; --revert restores it. Offline cannot observe a 404, so the self-test feeds the proposal build_proposal emits for one.

evals.name: unreachable_does_not_auto_remove
evals._note: Only removed_404/410 is a safe removal; unreachable (transient/egress) must NOT auto-apply.

evals.name: mislabeled_feed_flagged_not_auto_relabeled
evals._note: Executable since R6 via seed_curator --self-test: offline and write-free (temp audit log, in-memory catalogs; the live catalog and ledger are never touched). It exercises the real validate/propose/apply/revert functions and reports OBSERVED values, asserted here. A feed with bad authority / tier / missing purpose is flagged in label_issues; relabel is a proposal (safe_repair false) and an auto run changes nothing.

evals.name: discovery_from_ocps_is_proposal_only_and_reports_blocked_host
evals._note: OCPS newsroom (ocps.net, Finalsite) — autodiscovery surfaces candidates as proposals; an egress/policy-blocked host is reported, never bypassed.
